reviews.reason: Entity counts only (a box's wall cutting a frustum in a hyperbola): BRepAlgoAPI's solid of 8 faces, 16 edges and 11 vertices against the kernel's of 8 faces, 15 edges and 10 vertices. Each native solid has one edge and one vertex more: OCCT's conical face is periodic and keeps its seam, a ruling from a rim or section to another, as an edge with its own end vertex; the kernel's cone wall is one face traced in the plane normal to the axis (S9d.3a), its rims closed on one vertex and its sections on their own vertices, with no seam. The faces agree; the native result is valid with the reference's solid count and within the capture's allowance of the reference (every section an exact conic). The kernel's result validates and its volume, area and centre lie inside the reference's.
